NDT software in Chicago: what the local inspection market actually asks of you

Chicago is not one inspection market. It is several stacked on top of each other. Within two hours of the Loop an NDT contractor can be working a turnaround at ExxonMobil's Joliet refinery or Citgo's Lemont refinery, an outage at one of the northern Illinois nuclear stations such as Braidwood, Byron, Dresden, LaSalle or Quad Cities, a steel mill job across the state line in Northwest Indiana, a bridge or rail structure for a public owner, and shop inspection at a pressure vessel or structural fabricator in the western and southern suburbs. Add aviation maintenance work around O'Hare and Midway and you get a region where one company may run UT, RT, MT, PT, PAUT and eddy current in the same week for five very different clients, each with its own paperwork expectations.

The typical Chicago-area NDT contractor has somewhere between a handful and a few dozen technicians, mostly Level IIs doing field work, one or two Level IIIs owning the written practice and procedures, a radiography crew or two, and an office that still stitches quotes, certification records, calibration dates and invoices together from separate spreadsheets. That holds up until three clients audit you in the same month. The Atlantis ERP solution is built for that company: one system for certifications, procedures, instruments, dispatch, reports, quoting and invoicing, configured around how you already work. It is affordable, accessible and fully customizable, and pricing is quote on request.

ERP for NDT companies in Chicago: the direct answer

An ERP for NDT companies in Chicago has to handle multi-client, multi-method, multi-site work without losing track of who is certified for what and which instrument is in calibration on the day it goes out. The Atlantis ERP keeps all of that in one database, so technician certifications, procedures, equipment, crews, reports, quotes and invoices all hang off the same job record.

That matters here because the same technician might be on a nuclear outage one week and a refinery exchanger job the next. A generic ERP knows the technician is an employee; it does not know that his Level II UT expires in 60 days, that his near-vision test lapses before the outage ends, or that the thickness gauge in his truck is overdue for calibration. The Atlantis ERP was built around those NDT-specific facts. Each module is an app you can open individually, listed at the ERP apps overview, and they share data so nothing has to be typed twice.

Technician certification tracking software for Chicago nuclear, refinery and aviation work

Technician certification tracking in the Atlantis ERP means every certificate is a structured record, not a scanned PDF in a folder. The system flags expiring and expired certificates automatically and warns you before a technician with an invalid cert books time to a job.

Each record in the Certificates app holds the scheme (SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP or other), the level from trainee through Level III, the method, the certifying body, issue, expiry and renewal dates, industry sector, OJT hours, training hours, whether the exam was passed, and attachments. Status is computed for you: active, expiring soon (within 90 days), expired or revoked, with dedicated Expiring Soon and Expired menus. Vision tests are tracked separately with near vision (Jaeger J1 or J2), far vision, colour perception, contrast, examiner, clinic, the certificate file and expiry date.

For Chicago contractors this lines up with how clients check you. Nuclear outage work puts heavy weight on written-practice compliance and current eye exams. Aviation customers may run their own qualification requirements, which you can record under an "other" scheme. Radiography crews carry extra items the employee NDT profile already covers: radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry. Daily checks create warning tasks 90 days out, configurable email alerts go to the people you choose, and timesheets warn when a technician's certificate is not valid.

Calibration management software for instruments moving between Joliet, Lemont and the suburbs

Calibration management in the Atlantis ERP tracks every instrument and probe by serial number, with calibration frequency, status and next due date, and warns you if someone assigns an out-of-calibration unit to a job. Calibration certificates sit in a register with lab accreditation details and expiry alerts.

Chicago contractors move a lot of kit. A flaw detector might go to a Joliet exchanger job on Monday, back to the shop for a fabrication weld job on Wednesday, and out to a bridge on Friday. The Asset Management app records equipment type, assigned person, condition, asset tag, firmware, accessories and lifecycle stage (new, active, in calibration, in repair, rented out, retired, disposed). Issue and return run through a supervisor and manager approval workflow with the condition recorded at both ends, so when a transducer comes back cracked you know which job it was on.

Calibration records store provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, whether the lab was accredited, a pass, fail or conditional result and the next due date. Reservations prevent two crews claiming the same PAUT unit for overlapping dates. Consumables such as couplant, penetrant, developer, magnetic particles and PPE get reorder levels and a low-stock flag, which helps when a turnaround starts early and burns through a month of stock in a week. The maintenance log covers preventive and corrective work, cleaning, firmware updates and probe replacement with before and after condition.

Crew dispatch and scheduling software for Chicago turnarounds and outages

Crew dispatch in the Atlantis ERP runs each job as a team assignment that moves from planned to dispatched to in field to submitted to closed. Double-booking of technicians and of equipment serial numbers is blocked, and the system warns you if the assigned equipment is out of calibration.

Spring and fall are crowded in Chicagoland. Refinery turnarounds, nuclear refuelling outages and steel mill shutdowns can overlap, and every client wants the same experienced Level IIs. The Team Assignments app gives you a technician availability calendar covering assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable time, with overlaps blocked. Each technician shows status, current assignment, utilisation percentage and next available date, so when a client calls about a Lemont job you can see who is free without ringing round the crew. Time Off requests feed the same availability data.

Assignments hold site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates, and you can work in calendar, kanban or list view. If your radiography trucks run between sites, the Fleet app records whether each vehicle can carry radioactive sources, its transport licence number and expiry, and which project and driver it is assigned to, with dates and mileage. Illinois regulates radioactive materials as an Agreement State, so keeping source vehicles and badge records tidy is a practical daily concern for crews based in the city.

NDT reporting software for Chicago field crews

The Atlantis NDT reporting module covers 17 report types, each with its own numbering sequence: UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ECT, IRIS, PAUT, MFL, TOFD, PWHT, PMI, Hardness, UT thickness, Ferrite, Holiday/coating and Computed Radiography. Reports go through draft, in progress, review, approved and sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures.

Chicago's work mix uses most of that list. Refinery exchanger bundles call for IRIS and eddy current. Power plant condensers and feedwater heaters call for ECT. Fabrication shops want PAUT and TOFD on production welds, with weld lines recording defect type and orientation and an overall result of acceptable, not acceptable or acceptable with remarks. UT thickness readings are captured by direction. Method-specific fields include the UT probe calibration table, RT source, technique, IQI type and placement, MT technique and particle type, PT method and developer, PAUT focal laws and MFL scan mode. References to the work order, request, WPS, contract, drawing numbers, procedure and standard all sit on the report.

Reports print through versioned company templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML with your logo, header and footer. If a client insists on their own Excel form, fields map to cells and fill automatically. The offline field app works without signal, which matters under pipe racks and inside plant buildings, then syncs when the technician is back in coverage. For clients who want inspection results in 3D, see Digital Twin Reporting Software.

Procedures and Level III control

The Procedures app keeps one register of every written procedure with document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard such as ASME Section V, acceptance criteria and the body text or uploaded file. Approved revisions are locked, and every revision keeps a snapshot.

Chicago clients audit procedures hard, especially nuclear and aerospace customers. The workflow runs draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published, with rejected and archived states, and records who prepared, reviewed and approved each revision and when. Rejections carry a reason. Approvers get email notifications and reminders for pending approvals, so a procedure does not sit in someone's inbox while the job waits. An AI-assisted first draft can speed up a new procedure, falling back to a built-in template, but a Level III still reviews and approves it. Reports then reference the procedure, so an auditor can trace a result back to the revision in force on the day.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Chicago contractors

Quoting and invoicing in the Atlantis ERP are tied to the NDT job, so a quote becomes a sales order, the job's timesheets and equipment feed billing, and the invoice shows labour, equipment and consumables separately. You stop rebuilding the same numbers in three places.

Quotes in the Quotations app carry job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, and NDT service products are flagged with method and category. You get a branded quotation PDF, online acceptance and signature, and conversion to a sales order. Chicago clients often want quotes split by method and crew, and this structure handles that without custom spreadsheets.

Timesheets record work type (inspection, travel, standby, setup), method, billable flag, an overtime multiplier, site, client and equipment serial, with approval. Standby is a big line item at Chicago-area plants where permits and hot-work clearances hold crews at the gate. Invoices carry NDT project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, and lines carry cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician and days or hours. The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA, outstanding invoices, bills and expenses over twelve months. If your accountant lives in QuickBooks, NetSuite or SAP, the open REST API connects to them, scoped during implementation.

Winning more Chicago work with CRM

The CRM app is set up for NDT sales. Leads carry service line, lead source, NDT service type, industry sector, site country, and estimated technicians and days, and each gets an NDT lead score from 0 to 100 banded hot, warm, nurture or cold. You can import leads from CSV, preview an AI-personalised email and enrol a lead in a drip sequence.

Chicago has a deep bench of potential clients: refineries, utilities, fabricators, rail and transit owners, engineering firms and aviation operators. The Business Cards app lets a salesperson photograph a card at a trade event and turn it into a CRM lead in one click. Your company website's enquiry forms feed the same CRM, so nothing falls between the inbox and the sales pipeline.

Implementing the Atlantis ERP in Chicago

Implementation is done by Atlantis NDT, founded by Anoop Rayavarapu, an ASNT NDT Level III, so the people configuring your system understand written practices, calibration and report sign-off. Work is led remotely and done in phases so your crews keep working.

  1. Discovery: we review your current certificates, instrument list, report forms, quote templates and invoicing, and agree what goes live first.
  2. Data load: technician certifications, vision tests, instruments with calibration history and client contacts are imported.
  3. Templates: your report, quote and invoice layouts are rebuilt as versioned templates, including client-specific Excel forms.
  4. Field rollout: technicians install the offline field app and start submitting reports from site.
  5. Integration: accounting or client-system connections through the REST API are configured during implementation where you need them.

Anything specific to your Chicago clients, such as extra report fields for a particular owner or a custom approval step, is configured during implementation. Book an implementation call to map it out.

Affordable, customizable ERP for inspection companies in Chicago

If you are looking for affordable, customizable ERP for inspection companies in Chicago, the Atlantis ERP is set up for your methods, clients and paperwork rather than forcing you into a generic template. Smaller shops can start with certifications, equipment and reports and add quoting, invoicing and CRM later. Larger contractors running multiple crews across Illinois and Indiana can switch on everything at once. Training for your technicians is available too, with ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based courses delivered through the eLearning app and the Practical NDT 3D simulator. Request a demo for your Chicago team.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best NDT software for a Chicago inspection company?

The best fit is software that covers certifications, calibration, dispatch, reports and billing in one place, because Chicago contractors juggle refinery, nuclear, fabrication and infrastructure clients at once. The Atlantis ERP does that and is configured to your workflow.

Does the Atlantis ERP work for small NDT companies?

Yes. Small companies usually start with certificates, instruments and reporting, then add quoting, invoicing and CRM as they grow. The system is affordable and pricing is quote on request.

Can technicians write reports without signal inside a plant?

Yes. The offline field app stores drafts and photos locally, captures signatures on screen and syncs when the device is back online.

Can it connect to our accounting system?

Yes. The Atlantis ERP has an open REST API and integrates with QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Maximo or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation.

Does it track ISO 9712 and CP-189 certificates as well as SNT-TC-1A?

Yes. The certificate record supports SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP and other schemes, with level, method, certifying body and expiry.

Can it handle NCR and CAPA on fabrication work?

Yes. NCR and CAPA workflows can be configured during implementation and linked to the relevant job and report.

How do we get a price?

Pricing is quote on request and depends on the apps and configuration you need. Ask for a Chicago quote.
